title: Reversal of Hierarchical Advantage in V2X Intrusion Detection for Post-Quantum Intelligent Transportation Systems: code, protocol and results
description:
Complete computational record for the study: source code, evaluation protocol, hyperparameters, random seeds, automated test suite, run logs, and all result files behind the manuscript's tables.

The study re-evaluates hierarchical versus flat intrusion detection on the PQ-V2X dataset under a leakage-aware protocol: splits are grouped by predictor-value identity, because neither 5,000,000-record release contains 5,000,000 independent observations. All reported metrics come from a held-out test partition; the validation partition is never read. Stage 2 of the cascade is scored under oracle routing, under routing predicted by Stage 1, and end-to-end over every truly PQ/Hybrid record including those the cascade never routed.

The PQ-V2X data itself is not redistributed here; it is available from its own authors (doi:10.1109/JIOT.2025.3618153).
